scientific_integrity: A mathematical projection proof establishes the result. Finite numerical replay corroborates but does not prove the unrestricted theorem. Independent publication-priority verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two distinguishable independent walkers on a complete graph of size at least four; all positive hopping and coincidence loss strengths. Exact infinite-time results only, with no general finite-time decay estimate or heterogeneous-graph extension.
title: Collision-darkening and exchange-selective reaction on complete quantum networks
